description: pkix-path/src/lib.rs:2273-2277 — The commit 'fix: fail-closed BasicConstraints decode on intermediates' changed cert_basic_constraints (fail-open) to try_find_cert_ext (fail-closed). There is no test that exercises this new path: an intermediate certificate that HAS the BasicConstraints extension (so the OID is present in the TBS extensions list) but whose extension VALUE is malformed DER. Without such a test, a regression back to fail-open would not be caught. The existing nca-int fixture has NO BasicConstraints extension at all (returns None), which exercises the NotCA path, not the MalformedCertificate path. A fixture with BasicConstraints OID present but value = 0xFF (invalid DER) would cover this.
title: no test for MalformedCertificate on DER-invalid BasicConstraints in intermediate
